verdict.rationale: No evidence shows a native bulk-operation feature, such as multi-select edit or delete of alerts or dashboards. Bulk work is only implied through automation building blocks: dashboards-as-code and JSON specs, service accounts for automation scripts, and an MCP server and Agent Skills that let AI agents create or modify dashboards and manage alerts. The probe also found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk or batch operation capability in the UI or API, a documented bulk API endpoint or OpenAPI spec, and hands-on evidence of acting on many items at once.
